beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Grading window keyboard shortcuts: N next, B back, G type a score, F feedback, D date, T task menu, U link editor, O open in Schoology, S submit as a work sample, P post. Press ? or click the new ? button for a small menu of every shortcut that also runs the action when clicked.
• The review and verification windows get the same ? shortcut menu. Review keeps N, P, F, M, 1, 2, 3 and O; verification adds S to save, X for Save & Next, C for the calendar, L for layout options and H for the workflow help.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
